label: D2 after choosing a2 and reaching S2 (common), in the last trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2. Nearly all mass (>99%) is on steps where the agent chose a2 and saw S2 (a common transition). It never fires at D1 or GO, after a1, or when S1 is shown. It is also confined to the very end of the episode: 99.9% of activations are in ep_trials 90-99, and all of them fall in the lowest value bin (value < 5.2), where the value head is winding down near the episode end. Magnitude grows with trial number (ep_trial>=90 gives recall 0.99 with precision 0.43; >=95 gives precision 0.79 with recall 0.78) and with a run of consecutive a2->S2 trials (top windows are 4-5 straight a2/S2c trials, activation ramping 0.4 -> 1.0). Rate is higher when S2 is the good state, consistent with this. The predicate is a hard threshold on what is really a ramp with episode time, so precision and recall stay incomplete (dev F1 0.78, mass recall 0.94). It uses only variables the agent has observed at D2.
